title: Reply counts change without Message state
description: From batch-5 verify of y3f2.3 (b7b2afbc). Message/get returns server-set replyCount/unreadReplyCount, but creating a reply or advancing ReadPosition does not mark the parent Message changed, so Message/changes never reports it and clients keep stale counts (RFC 8620 §5.2). Sibling of y3f2.12 (Chat unreadCount).
close_reason: Landed in 8b53aa52 fix(chat-server)!: thread counts bump Message state (batch 6, adversarially verified, CI green at a586c251)
